quest_lastdenn_ryiah.name: Ryiah
quest_lastdenn_ryiah.comment: WARNING: phraseId 20 is used in a conv condition.

text: Psst. You there, with the face that says "bad ideas welcome".
They threw me in this cell because they think I'm a witch.
And true, I am a witch. But that's not the point.
Witches don't belong in jail. They belong outside jails, where they can be free to do witchy things.
If you'll help me achieve that, perhaps I can use those witchy things to help you out in return.

choices.text: *No illegal prison break for you. Take your leave.*

text: A guard is off duty somewhere in the bar.
How do I know that? Because I'm a witch! I know things.
He has my jail key. And you need to get it from him.
He is probably drunk, so this shouldn't be too difficult, but also not easy.
Don't forget, my freedom is on the line here. Good luck!
You're back?
Do you have the jail key? Are you serious? What are you waiting for?
*Hic*
Hey. *Hic* I'm off duty. Way... way off duty.
Whatever it is, take it to the night shift. They're on. I'm on... this bottle.
You're actually going to stand there until I hear you out?
Fine. I've had a few drinks and I've got a few minutes. *Hic* What?

choices.text: [Barbarian 1] *Loom over him. Demand his jail key.*
[Diplomat 1] *Guard to guard - ask for his jail key.*
[Jester 1] *Joke, then ask to borrow his jail key.*
*Hold out your hand for the key.*
*Warn him of trouble on his block.*
*Let him be with his drink. Take your leave.*

text: The jail key? *Hic* You walk up to a stranger and ask for the cells. In a bar. Boldest thing I've heard since... the last bold thing.
Trouble on my block? *Hic* Then it's the night shift's block now. Not mine. Not 'til the morning bell. Maybe noon.
The key, is it? *Hic* Back up. Back up first, before you go making demands.
I've had a few but I know that look. *Hic* I'm not looking for trouble. But I'm also not... scared.

choices.text: *Let him be with his drink. Take your leave.*

text: Farren sent you? *Hic* Then Farren can drag himself down here and say so. He won't. He never does.
Buy me a drink and I'll love you for it. *Hic* Won't pry these keys loose, but I'll love you.
One guard to another, eh? *Hic* Aye. Sat where you sit. Stood where you stand. Fell where you're... you're not falling. Good lad.
But the keys stay on my belt, friend. That's the one rule even I don't drink past.

choices.text: *Let him be with his drink. Take your leave.*

text: Sergeant's on rounds 'til two. *Hic* And he hates being bothered. Found that out twice. Slow learner.
In writing. On a beer-soaked mat. *Hic* Twelve years I've worn this badge. A wet napkin won't save my neck.
*Hic* Ha! The ale. Aye, it's horse-piss, isn't it. Glorious horse-piss.
You're decent company, stranger. But decent company doesn't get the cells handed to it. Sorry.

choices.text: [Diplomat 1] *Turn the joke into a real ask.*
*Bet him the key on the dice.*
*Let him be with his drink. Take your leave.*

text: Dice? For my keys? *Hic* Hah! I'm drunk, friend, not stupid. Well. Mostly not stupid.
My replacement? *Hic* Nobody told me. Nobody ever tells me a thing. Maybe because I'm drunk... Still no key for you.
You had me braced for a brawl. *Hic* This reasonable voice of yours is worse, somehow.
...It's working. A little. Don't tell a soul.

choices.text: *Let him be with his drink. Take your leave.*

text: Back to growling? *Hic* We were past that, you and me. We had a moment. Don't go ruining the moment.
Urgent, urgent. *Hic* Everything's urgent after the fourth cup. Sit. Breathe.
I was set to throw you out, and here I am laughing instead. *Hic* Low trick, that.
Go on, then. You've earned another word out of me, at least.

choices.text: *Let him be with his drink. Take your leave.*

text: Report me? *Hic* I'm OFF duty. Look at me. Does this look on-duty? This is a man at peace. Leave the peace be.
*Hic* Heh. Funny. You're a funny one. Funny gets you my respect. Gets you no keys. Just respect.
That warm, reasonable voice had iron under it all along, hadn't it. *Hic* Sneaky. I shouldn't like sneaky. The ale does.
...By Evdos. Alright. You've got my attention. *Hic* Both kinds. All the kinds I've got left.

choices.text: *Let him be with his drink. Take your leave.*

text: Hurry, hurry. *Hic* A breath ago you had all night. Now it's a race? Pick a speed, friend. I've only got the one.
A good cause. *Hic* They're all good causes by this hour. The bottle agrees. The bottle's very agreeable.
A clerk's good sense and a fool's good humour, in the one person. *Hic* I can't place you at all.
Strange, but I like you. *Hic* Doesn't change the rule. ...Probably doesn't.

choices.text: *Let him be with his drink. Take your leave.*

text: Coin? *Hic* You think I'm cheap. Maybe I am. But I'm not key-cheap. Not tonight.
*Hic* Now you'll have me weeping into the cup. I manage that fine alone, every night, thanks.
The laughing stops cold the moment you want it to, doesn't it. *Hic* Brrr. Do it again. No - don't. Don't!
...You're more than a clown, aren't you. *Hic* Right. Right. That's nearly sobered me. Nearly.

choices.text: *Let him be with his drink. Take your leave.*

text: Hands. *Hic* Hands off the coat. It's all that's holding me upright.
Empty cells? *Hic* There's a witch in one of 'em, friend. That's the whole trouble, isn't it.
All those jokes, and underneath you're steady as a judge. *Hic*
...By Evdos. It's working, isn't it. *Hic* I can feel it working. Stop being so persuasive at me.

choices.text: *Ask him to look the other way.*
*Let him be with his drink. Take your leave.*

text: Look the other way? *Hic* I've stared at the bottom of this cup all night. That's the only way I look now.
*Hic* Heh. Good company, you. Bad influence, good company. *Hic* Still no.
*Hic* Ah, blast it. You've gone and made me laugh, and a laughing man can't say no. It's practically medical. ...You win. Evdos help me, you win.
*Hic* You and that reasonable voice of yours. I've run clean out of arguments to throw back. ...Fine. Fine.
*Hic* Look at me. Grinning like a fool into my own cup. *Hic* Can't refuse a man who does that to me. New rule. ...You've won.
*Hic* That cold look of yours. I'm too drunk and too old to stare it down. *Hic* My staring's all spent. ...Alright. You've got me.
*Hic* No... no, you're right, aren't you. And I'm too tired to keep saying you're not. ...Alright. *Hic* Alright.
*Hic* By Evdos, that quiet of yours gets right into a man's bones. *Hic* Stop it. Stop. ...You've won.
Here. *Hic* The jail key. Don't make me regret this more than the morning already will. And it will.
I want it back before the dawn bell. *Hic* Not one toll after. Or I'll be... I'll be very disappointed at you.
And if anyone asks - you never saw me. *Hic* I was home. Fast asleep. Dreaming of a job where folk stop asking me for keys.
You again. *Hic* I still have it. Just... take it before I sober up and reconsider.
I've said my piece. *Hic* Go on. Go home, the both of us.
Wait. Who are you? My new guard, or my new favorite person?
Actually, do not answer. I am deciding you are my new favorite person.
Before I make my dramatic exit, anything you want to say?
You did it! You actually did it! I am out!
I know I can be a handful, but I promised to be useful, and I keep my promises.

choices.text: *Briefly explain your time-travel predicament to defeat Ardor.*
*Ask Ryiah to join you on your quest.* [BLUE](Join party)
*Tell her you don't need her help right now.*

14.name: Ryiah
text: You just broke a witch out of jail. Let's make it worth the trouble.

20.name: Ryiah
text: Fine, but don't forget that I owe you one. If you ever need my help, just ask.

9000.name: Ryiah
text: I cannot repay my debt to you if I cannot join you. Make some room in your party and then talk to me again.
You're dismissing a witch. Bold move.
I do hope you've thought about what you're giving up here.

choices.text: *Yes, you've thought about it. She can go.* [BLUE](Dismiss Ryiah)

text: Fine. Don't come crying to me when things go sideways without magical backup.
All her equipment will also be gone once you bury her.
Oh, you came back. Ran into trouble without your witch, did you?

choices.text: *Yes. Without a witch, this party is just problems.* [BLUE](Join party)
*No, you just happened to walk past.*

text: Thought so. I still owe you one anyway. Let's go.
Sure you did. I'll be here when you're ready to stop lying to yourself.
I would love nothing more than to rejoin you. But even a witch can see there's no room. Come back when you've made space.
